name: usage_impact
description: Report how many pages are currently typed with a class, and how many links use a relation — the blast radius of renaming, retyping, or removing a term. Consult it before proposing a schema edit that touches an in-use term, so you can weigh the cost of the change against the benefit.

term.description: A class or relation CURIE (e.g. `frona:Service`, `schema:worksFor`) to measure.
